I completely understand how important these essential grocery items are for you tomorrow. 

While I cannot change the address in the system, I can definitely add a specific note to the delivery manifest for our local hub and alert the dispatch team to try and contact the delivery agent directly. 

Let me forward this urgent request to our senior logistics desk right away to see if they can hold it or coordinate a revised drop-off. Please stay on the line for just a moment while I log this escalation.
